trigger: Root reported Bili HEVC hardware session submitted64 packets and delivered0 before native fallback. Missing parameter-set bootstrap for AnnexB extradata is a hypothesis, not yet proven for that stream.

source_review.FFmpeg7.1.5: hevc_mp4toannexb passes packets unchanged when input extradata is already AnnexB; only hvcC branch automatically prepends extradata at IRAP.
source_review.MozillaLinux: Pinned upstream Linux FFmpeg backend requests HVCC and copies supplied extradata; Android-specific conversion is not evidence that Linux Bili uses AnnexB. Actual input versus BSF output must be distinguished by diagnostic logs.

change: Per hardware generation, inspect fresh BSF packets; a complete in-band parameter set marks configuration seeded and is unchanged.

At first IRAP/key AU missing any necessary type, seed a complete dependency-ordered parameter configuration from BSF output extradata, filtering exclusively VPS/SPS/PPS for HEVC or SPS/PPS for H264. Preserve leading AUD first and all original in-band updates afterward.
Avoid prefixing only missing types before an in-band SPS/VPS: a complete cached prefix keeps PPS after SPS, while later in-band NALs override it.
No VCL, AUD, SEI or second access unit is copied from extradata. Never rewrite original replay packets.
Reset the seeded marker on flush so the next random-access AU bootstraps again.

Bounded stderr diagnostics record input and BSF-output extradata size/first8hex/AnnexBparameter mask before hardware open, plus first input/filtered AU type/count/mask per generation. Software fallback still logs its first original packet.

manifest.selection: Cedar wrappers lead av_codec_iterate and avcodec_find_decoder; native names h264/hevc remain available for fallback.
manifest.software_codecs: All available in-tree decoders/parsers retained; external codec libraries not auto-detected or linked. Native h264/hevc and audio fallback retained.
manifest.sandbox: No sandbox disabling. Hardware API resolved only from an already-preloaded, already-connected client.
limits: Bounded replay fallback only before a hardware frame is delivered; post-delivery hardware errors remain explicit.
No assertion of hardware use based on Firefox software-frame backend labels.
No system library installation or target execution by this builder.

new_cases: RealH264/HEVC fixture converted to AnnexBextradata and key AU with in-band parameters removed
Leading AUD preserved before parameter prefix
Only first random-access AU per generation receives prefix
Complete in-band AU remains byte-for-byte unchanged
OriginalHVCC/avcC output remains byte-for-byte equal to upstream BSF output
Partial in-band HEVCVPS-only/SPS-only and H264SPS-only retain dependency order and original in-band updates
